#Module websocket

WebSocket and CloseEvent. Messages arrive as "message" events: text in Event_data, or a buffer in Event_object.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/websocket.widl.

Odin: import "wren:websocket".

#Types

#handle WebSocket : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_WebSocket).

#enum WebSocketState : i32

WebSocket.readyState

membervalue
Connecting0
Open1
Closing2
Closed3

#WebSocket_create

WebSocket WebSocket_create(string url, string protocols = "") raises

new WebSocket(url, protocols): protocols is a comma-separated list ("" = none). Syntax for an invalid URL or protocol list.

Odin: websocket.create.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

#WebSocket_close

void WebSocket_close(WebSocket socket, i32 code = -1, string reason = "") raises

socket.close(code, reason): code < 0 means absent. Invalid_Access for a code that is not 1000 or 3000-4999, Syntax for a reason over 123 bytes.

Odin: websocket.close.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: WebSocket_close :: proc(c: ^Call, socket: Api_WebSocket, code: i32, reason: string) -> Api_Error
